text: New workspace setup requires our IT team to manually configure SSO before any teammate can log in.
Configuring SSO for our new account took two weeks of back-and-forth with support.
The onboarding checklist never tells us when a step is actually complete so we redo steps we already finished.
The onboarding checklist step for connecting our billing system does not say what connected actually looks like.
We had to contact support three separate times just to get our first workspace configured correctly.
Nobody on our team knew which onboarding step was blocking the rest of the workflow.
Our support ticket about a broken SSO redirect got closed without being resolved so we had to reopen it twice.
Task deadline notifications during onboarding only arrive after the deadline has already passed.
